	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h1>Kite House Sardinia | Kitesurf Resort Punta Trettu</h1>

		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div id="home" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1769981510928"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-8"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1769039111305" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h2>Kitesurf School &amp; Holiday Homes in South Sardinia</h2>

		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1769987618491" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><strong>Kite House Sardinia</strong> is a family-run <strong>kitesurf resort</strong> and <strong>IKO kitesurf school in Punta Trettu, South Sardinia</strong> — ideal for a <strong>kitesurfing holiday in Sardinia</strong>.</p>
<p>Stay in our <strong>holiday homes</strong> and ride at the most famous local spots: <strong>Punta Trettu</strong> and <strong>Porto Botte</strong>, just a short drive away.</p>
<p><strong>Punta Trettu</strong> is a shallow, flat-water lagoon — perfect for <strong>beginners</strong> and <strong>fast progression</strong>.</p>
<p>The town of <strong>Sant’Antioco</strong> is only a few minutes away, with restaurants, shops, and bars.</p>
<p>Our <strong>holiday homes</strong> are surrounded by a beautiful garden with a large <strong>swimming pool</strong>, a jacuzzi, barbecue areas, and private parking. Among palms, ancient olive trees, and flowers, <strong>Kite House Sardinia</strong> is the ideal place for a relaxing <strong>kitesurf holiday in Sardinia</strong>, focused on sport, nature, and outdoor living.</p>
<p>All accommodations feature one or two bedrooms, a living room with a fully equipped <strong>kitchen</strong>, a bathroom with a shower, air conditioning, high-speed <strong>Wi-Fi</strong>, and a private porch with hammocks.</p>

		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1769040634673" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Accommodation Services</h3>

		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1773225491725" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p class="kh-services">● Apartments with fully equipped kitchens ● High-speed Wi-Fi ● Private parking ● Large garden ● Pool &amp; jacuzzi ● BBQ area &amp; outdoor kitchen ● Local &amp; organic food ● Washing machine ● Pets allowed (on request) ● Fitness area ● On-site massage (by request) ● Beach volley &amp; mini football  ● Trampoline &amp; slackline ● Bike pump track ● Kids’ playground ● Clubhouse dinners ● Restaurant tips ● E-bike rental ● Transfers &amp; car rental</p>

		</div>
	</div>

		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element vc_custom_1769039105430">
<div class="wpb_wrapper">
<h2>Kitesurf School Punta Trettu – IKO Center Sardinia</h2>
</div>
</div>
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
<div class="wpb_wrapper"></div>
</div>

		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>At <strong>Kite House Sardinia</strong>, we welcome kiters of all levels and offer a complete range of services, including <strong>kitesurf lessons</strong>, <strong>equipment rental</strong>, and on-spot support directly at our <strong>Punta Trettu</strong> base.</p>
<p>The <strong>Kite House Sardinia ASD</strong> kitesurf school is located directly on the resort property and is an official <strong>IKO affiliate</strong>. We run <strong>kitesurf courses for all levels and ages</strong>, led by certified, experienced, multilingual instructors.</p>
<p>For clear communication and faster learning, students use <strong>radio helmets</strong>.<br />
At the end of the course, you receive an <strong>IKO certification</strong> confirming your riding level.</p>
<p>Most lessons take place at <strong>Punta Trettu</strong>, the famous shallow, flat-water lagoon—ideal for safe and fast progression.<br />
Depending on wind direction, we also teach at nearby spots such as <strong>Porto Botte</strong> and <strong>Is Solinas</strong>. See all locations on our <a href="/kitesurf-sardinia/"><strong>kitesurf spots in South Sardinia</strong></a> page.</p>
<p>In addition to lessons, we offer <strong>advanced coaching</strong>, <strong>wing foil courses</strong>, <strong>assistance &amp; supervision</strong>, <strong>rescue service</strong>, <strong>kite repairs</strong>, and <strong>equipment rental</strong>.</p>

		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1769040618202" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Kitesurf Services</h3>

		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1769976194151" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p class="kh-services">● Kitesurf courses ● Riding lessons ● Kite courses for children ● Kitesurf equipment rental ● Assistance &amp; supervision ● Advanced coaching ● Guide for downwind ● Equipment washing area ● Storage ● Private kite spot ● Wind forecast &amp; kitesurfing tips ● Kite repairs ● Rescue service</p>

		</div>
	</div>

		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h2>Sports, Relax &amp; Wellness</h2>

		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>At <strong>Kite House Sardinia</strong>, you can combine kitesurfing with relaxing and fun activities on non-windy days. We offer <strong>yoga classes</strong>, <strong>massages</strong>, <strong>SUP tours</strong>, <strong>surf sessions</strong>, <strong>e-bike rental</strong>, and a small fitness area to help you stay active and recover after your kite sessions.</p>
<p>Through trusted local partners, we can also arrange <strong>bike tours and excursions</strong>, <strong>windsurfing</strong>, <strong>horse riding</strong>, <strong>diving</strong>, <strong>boat rentals</strong>, and more.</p>
<p>And of course, we’re always happy to share our best tips on <strong>kite conditions</strong>, <strong>beaches to visit</strong>, <strong>restaurants</strong>, and local spots, so you can make the most of your <strong>holiday in South Sardinia</strong>.</p>

				<div class="pswp__caption__center"></div>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
</div>
